pages.title: Quem guarda o limite
pages.scene: Morning in the same inhabited shell square. Adra LEFT asks Talin RIGHT, ADULT elf trail keeper with light bronze skin, cropped auburn hair, thin leaf-shaped scar on RIGHT cheek, ochre cloak and ash staff, to accompany a community patrol of the LEGAL path. Ferry boat tied nearby; no sanctuary entry approved.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: A escola pode olhar a trilha. O bosque exige guardião.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Vou com vocês até a pedra, não além dela.

pages.title: A autorização do povo
pages.scene: Council house shell mosaic, oak table, two copper lamps in daylight. Talin LEFT signs a local consent for patrol of the marked footpath; Sere RIGHT shows her existing municipal permit separately. Neither document changes the prohibition on sanctuary entry. Single clean close inset of two documents, no garbled readable words in art.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: A trilha da vila, sim. A raiz sagrada, não.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: A licença da cidade diz o mesmo. Vamos respeitar ambas.

pages.title: Quatro pares de passos
pages.scene: Return by foot WEST along same marked willow trail from the hamlet. Sere LEFT and Talin RIGHT lead; Ilyan and Runa each ONCE in smaller middle distance. Distinct clothing and faces, boundary stone still ahead, no sudden transport. Light rain starts but there is existing stream water by path.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Distância entre nós. Ninguém tapa a visão do outro.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: O posto de madeira é antes da pedra. Comecemos lá.

pages.title: A segunda peça
pages.scene: At a wooden three-root patrol post on the legal path SOUTH of the sanctuary stone, Talin LEFT notices a SECOND separate iron-and-rope snare hidden among wet leaves, not the first snare preserved in the council house. Ilyan RIGHT stops short before touching it. Close inset of trip wire attached to stake. One of each character and one snare.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: Mais um laço. Está armado agora.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Pisem onde piso. A corda corta a trilha inteira.

pages.title: Calço de oficina
pages.scene: Same post, same SECOND live snare. Ilyan LEFT uses his practical measuring-case wooden wedge to hold the spring down safely; his BLUNT sword remains sheathed. Runa RIGHT notes position before he cuts the outer line, using no spell. Distinct hands, no extra fingers. Marked trail and boundary visible far north.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Primeiro travo a mola. Depois tiro a tensão.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: Anotei lugar e hora. Agora pode soltar.

pages.title: Calcanhar de ferro
pages.scene: At the same post after safe disarming, Sere LEFT points to one fresh adult human bootprint with an uneven heel and a gray fabric thread caught on bark; Talin RIGHT examines it. No invented named owner yet, no claim about the earlier trap. Clear close panel of footprint, single set of marks.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Um salto gasto deixou a marca de lado.

lines.speaker: Talin
lines.text: O dono passou depois da chuva desta manhã.

pages.title: Um vulto na margem da trilha
pages.scene: From marked path SOUTH of boundary, Sere LEFT sees ONE distant adult human Daro RIGHT in gray leather coat, dark red scarf, black hair shaved at sides, white scar above RIGHT eyebrow. He stands near old willow bend reaching toward the SECOND snare location but sees patrol and recoils. He has not crossed the sanctuary yet. Sere raises bow but does not fire.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Pare onde está. Esta trilha é usada pela vila.

lines.speaker: Daro
lines.text: O ferro é meu. Saiam da frente.

pages.title: O homem do lenço
pages.scene: Daro LEFT shown clearly for identity lock: adult human olive skin, side-shaved black hair, stubble, white scar RIGHT eyebrow, dark RED scarf, gray leather coat, uneven heel boot; he grips a boat hook used as tool, not a magic weapon. Adra RIGHT confronts from the community trail wearing indigo and shell braids. No proof he placed FIRST trap. Other party behind out of frame.

lines.speaker: Daro
lines.text: Comprei a corda. Não comprei uma plateia.

lines.speaker: Adra
lines.text: Você armou ferro onde meu povo caminha.

pages.title: A resposta errada
pages.scene: Daro LEFT throws a weighted cargo net across the LEGAL footpath to hinder Ilyan RIGHT. Ilyan braces with blunt practice sword crosswise, no wound. ONE net, physically plausible direction left to right, willow roots and same boundary stone far back. Maintain Daro's scar on right eyebrow and dark red neck scarf; Ilyan 17 clean shaven long black wavy hair.

lines.speaker: Daro
lines.text: Eu disse: saiam!

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Largue o gancho. Ninguém precisa se ferir!

pages.title: Uma guarda sem fio
pages.scene: Immediate continuation: Ilyan LEFT catches Daro's hooked pole with his BLUNT short practice sword and turns it toward the ground, protecting the group; Daro RIGHT stays adult with dark red scarf and white RIGHT eyebrow scar. The net is on ground behind Ilyan, not duplicated. No stabbing, no severed limbs, same legal path.

lines.speaker: Ilyan
lines.text: Fique na trilha. Solte a arma.

lines.speaker: Daro
lines.text: Ela era uma ferramenta até você chegar.

pages.title: Chuva sob os pés
pages.scene: Runa LEFT guides EXISTING rainwater from a shallow rut on the path to muddy ground near Daro's boot, slowing but not binding him. Her floral tattoo LEFT arm and silver septum clear. Sere RIGHT sights along ash bow at a hanging cargo rope ABOVE Daro, never at his body. Daro's feet visible as small inset only ONCE, no extra human copy.

lines.speaker: Runa
lines.text: A água já está aqui. Posso diminuir a corrida.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: A corda de cima. A pessoa, não.

pages.title: Flecha no cabo
pages.scene: Sere LEFT releases one arrow into a taut suspended cargo ROPE ABOVE and behind Daro RIGHT, cutting the rope so the already-thrown net drops between him and the team. Arrow does not hit the human. Daro stumbles but is not maimed. The legal willow path and boundary marker remain physically consistent.

lines.speaker: Sere
lines.text: Abaixo do cabo, agora!

lines.speaker: Daro
lines.text: Vocês nem sabem de quem é este bosque!
